content:
sam (infra): Heads-up: onprem-agent v3.4.1 is marked available for GA. Key items: FIPS-compatible TLS mode, improved image signing checks for air-gapped installs, and a smaller footprint container for edge customers. Docs + upgrade procedure: https://internal.redwood/docs/onprem-agent-3.4.1. Please read if you own CSM/SRE/CS.
lee (support): Do we have a scheduled maintenance window for customers who require an orchestrated upgrade? Some enterprise accounts asked for a weekend option.
sam (infra): Yes. Suggested windows: Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC and Sun 03:00-07:00 UTC next weekend. We'll publish the maintenance calendar and opt-in signup for managed upgrades.
nora (compliance): Note: FIPS mode requires customers to enable fips_mode: true and use certified HSM images. We added a checklist for auditors and a sample attestation statement. Also updating contract annex A to reflect FIPS compatibility disclaimers.
deploy-bot: Release pipeline started: onprem-agent-3.4.1 -> canary (CI #4678). Canary targets 5 internal clusters. ETA 4h. :rocket:
cecil (ops): For air-gapped installs, the new image signer supports offline manifest verification. We'll need to ship the signer tool and a checksum bundle. Planning to publish a tarball in the private-releases bucket.
maya (prod): Action: prod-comm to prepare a customer advisory and a short migration guide (SMB vs Enterprise paths). Also need communication for Dedicated customers about temporary performance impact during live upgrades. Who will own the advisory?
oliver (engineering): I'll own the migration guide and include the rollback steps. Quick snippet for the upgrade manifest we recommend:
```yaml
upgrade:
  agent_version: "3.4.1"
  fips_mode: false # set true if using FIPS/TLS
  prechecks:
    - disk_space >= 1GB
    - hsm_connected if fips_mode
  backup: true
```
lee (support): Please include the commands for collecting pre-upgrade debug bundles. Also add an explicit `--no-auto-reboot` flag for customers who prefer manual reboots.
sam (infra): Good call. We'll enable --no-auto-reboot in the package. Ops will run a dry-run upgrade against staging clusters tomorrow 06:00 UTC and post results.
nora (compliance): One more: telemetry defaults for this agent remain unchanged (opt-in for telemetry). We added language to the release note so sales doesn't accidentally promise otherwise.
maya (prod): I'll draft the customer advisory and a one-pager for CSMs by EOD. @cecil can you confirm the tarball location + expiry policy for air-gapped customers?
cecil (ops): Confirmed: private-releases/onprem/3.4.1/ (signed). Tarball signed, expiry: 90 days. We will rotate signatures monthly.
deploy-bot: Canary step completed: 5/5 targets healthy. Proceeding to staged rollout.
sam (infra): Thanks team. Final checklist: docs link, migration guide, tarball + signer, maintenance calendar, CSM one-pager, and contract annex draft. Update tracker: https://internal.redwood/tracker/ONP-341. Close channel unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
